unit.why: A short anecdote: someone visits R. Yehiel Michel of Zlotchov before prayer, and the rebbe's reply shows that he had already completed the yihudim of the whole prayer.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי ממחותני הרב המפורסם מהר"י ז"ל מברעזנא
stories.summary_en: When a man came to R. Yehiel Michel of Zlotchov before prayer, the tsaddik said he was already holding at a certain point, because he first meditated all the yihudim of the prayer and only then said the words.
